decisions.reason: Selecting uniform proportional scaling for the second V does not change the independent rule requiring the É accent to be a literal extraction of the Hero V terminal.
The source's E-and-L scale adjustment is already represented by the candidate's message-167 MODIFY, and no additional update or removal is required.
The decision uses the approved Hero V as the unchanged source geometry and modifies only how the second V is derived from it.
The resulting hierarchy and unchanged second-V size are already represented by the candidate's message-167 MODIFY; its remaining peak and restrained-echo rules remain valid.
Changing the second V's derivation method does not alter the required peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent.
The source selects the second V baseline but does not change the policy requiring approved signature assets to be preserved in subsequent iterations.
The source selects a second-V construction and adjusts E/L scale without changing the established L–V spacing reference or broader kerning goals.
The second-V geometry decision has no effect on the deferred champagne-metal material treatment.
The design selection does not change the requirement to provide short rationales for design rounds.
The source retains the existing wordmark composition and does not change its all-caps case treatment.
The second-V construction decision is unrelated to accessible review-image delivery formats.
